name: Ivan Varko
title: CEO & Founder
bio: Founder of DeoVR, the leading immersive streaming platform and enterprise solution, turning what was once thought “mission impossible” into amazing experiences for millions of users.We’re building fully interactive, multi-user immersive streaming technology that lets millions of people watch, touch, interact, and connect like never before - setting the stage for the next generation of media.I lead a passionate team of AI specialists, product engineers, developers, and business operations pros. Together we’ve pioneered immersive tech including our VR streaming app, interactive AR/Passthrough experiences, and groundbreaking haptics integrations.
